events.text: The village fair has come to town. Half the county is queueing at the door.
events.title: Fair Day

events.text: Rain all afternoon. The queue never formed, but the pickpockets loved it.
events.title: Rain on the Cobbles

events.text: The wardens patrol the galleries tonight. Nothing will go missing.
events.title: The Wardens Walk

events.text: There is a low red moon over the dig, and the town feels untrustworthy.
events.title: Thief's Moon

events.text: One of the curators has taken the day. The storeroom will have to wait.
events.title: Curator's Holiday

events.text: A volunteer has turned up to help catalogue. Twice the usual work.
events.title: An Extra Pair of Hands

events.text: A piece about the museum ran in the county paper. People are charmed by it.
events.title: A Notice in the Paper

events.text: Traders have taken the square, and half of them have come to see what the museum has dug up.
events.title: Market Day

events.text: The fair was called off at dawn. There is no crowd, and no pickpockets with it.
events.title: The Market Fails

events.text: The lamps stay lit all night and the watch walks with them. The cases are safer than usual.
events.title: Lantern Night

events.text: The gallery has been packed since noon and nobody is watching the cases.
events.title: A Crowded Night

events.text: Half the staff are abed with a fever. The storeroom will have to wait.
events.title: Fever in the Ranks

events.text: A party of menders has come down from the hill to help clear the backlog.
events.title: The Menders Come

events.text: Nothing out of the ordinary. The gallery opens, and it opens again.
events.title: An Ordinary Day
